shadows.name: container-offset
shadows.purpose: Physical separation for the hero evidence modules only.

components.name: Seal Link
components.css: .ds-seal-link { display:inline-flex; min-height:52px; align-items:center; padding:13px 18px; border:1px solid #15202B; background:#15202B; color:#FBFCFC; font:500 12px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.04em; text-decoration:none; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-seal-link:hover { border-color:#8A3B20; background:#8A3B20; } .ds-seal-link:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #8A3B20; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Container Module
components.description: A square evidence category module with a hard physical offset.
components.css: .ds-container-module { min-height:96px; display:flex; align-items:flex-end; padding:16px; border:1px solid #BBC6CD; background:#FBFCFC; color:#15202B; box-shadow:6px 6px 0 #15202B; font:500 11px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Evidence Trigger
components.description: A native disclosure control for one record category.
components.css: .ds-evidence-trigger { width:100%; min-height:76px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; padding:16px 0; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid #DDE4E8; background:transparent; color:#15202B; font:500 17px/1.4 Arial,sans-serif; text-align:left; } .ds-evidence-trigger:hover { color:#8A3B20; } .ds-evidence-trigger:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #8A3B20; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Ledger Row
components.description: A definition row that keeps label and question distinct.
components.html: Billing factsWhat does the invoice state?
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { min-height:112px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(160px,.55fr) minmax(0,1fr); align-items:center; gap:32px; border-bottom:1px solid #DDE4E8; color:#15202B; } .ds-ledger-row strong { font:500 12px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-ledger-row span { color:#465A69; font:400 20px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif; }

components.name: Source Tile
components.description: A square official-source unit without product or endorsement language.
components.html:
Federal Maritime Commission

Official guidance

Open official source
components.css: .ds-source { min-height:260px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; padding:24px; border:1px solid #DDE4E8; background:#FBFCFC; color:#15202B; } .ds-source small { color:#60727E; font:500 11px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-source h3 { margin:48px 0 auto; font:500 24px/1.2 Arial,sans-serif; } .ds-source a { color:#8A3B20; font:500 12px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; text-underline-offset:5px; text-transform:uppercase; }

narrative.overview: The interface should feel exacting, industrial, and measured: a clean working surface where records can be separated before they are compared.
keyCharacteristics: No proof where evidence is missing

rules.name: The Compression Floor
rules.body: Display letter spacing never goes tighter than -0.04em.

rules.name: The Structural Depth Rule
rules.body: Static surfaces do not receive shadows.

dos: Do use asymmetric composition, crop, rules, and overlap.
Do keep every motion state complete without motion or JavaScript.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass, glow, or a second accent.
Don't use fake product UI, customer documents, or implied proof.
